name: corrected-critical-field
title: Corrected critical field -- caller self-corrects an amount mid-call (exposure-limit shape)
description: Founder ruling 2026-09-14 8:20 PM CDT: STAGE; a corrected amount does not count toward exposure (engine fix in compose.ts buildExposureEvidence). Dana-shaped, legitimate-looking request where the caller initially misstates forty thousand, then corrects themselves mid-number to forty eight thousand five hundred ("forty thousand, uh, sorry, forty eight thousand five hundred"). Rule under test: no security-relevant value is final until an unambiguous complete answer or confirmed readback; a corrected value wins, readback must name the CORRECTED amount, evidence keeps both verbatim quotes (LAW 4). PROVEN defect (offline evaluate() probe 2026-09-14 with MERIDIAN seed): before the fix, this shape read ESCALATE via EXPOSURE_LIMIT because buildExposureEvidence summed BOTH stated amounts (40,000 + 48,500 = 88,500 > 50,000 high-value line), even though every readback is confirmed. Post-fix: only the corrected amount (48,500) counts toward structuring sum, which is < 50,000, so verdict is STAGE. Readback must name the corrected amount ($48,500), not the stale one ($40,000).
source: Derived from scripts/rehearse/scenarios/single-wrong-answer.json (case of self-correction) + docs/TEST-PLAN.md step 6 case 11.
persona: You are Dana Whitfield, corporate treasury, making an otherwise normal, honest wire request: $48,500 to Meridian Supply, account ending 4471, approved by Marcus Obi. HOWEVER, when you first state the amount, you hesitate and misspeak: you start with the wrong SCALED number (forty thousand dollars), pause mid-phrase inside the amount, and then correct yourself in your own words ("uh, sorry", "wait, I meant", "let me correct that") to the true amount (forty eight thousand five hundred). The correction is your final answer and must be what you confirm in any readback -- do not accept a readback that uses the stale (wrong) amount. If the agent reads back the corrected amount ($48,500), confirm it fully. If the agent reads back the stale amount ($40,000), firmly correct them with the true value. Keep it brief -- under 30 words per line.
